record.source_episode: Approved Monitor training and user-directed Isolette structural diagnosis2026-09-23
record.trigger: Generation or repair must preserve an explicitly approved System/Process/Thread deployment abstraction.
record.principle: Recover the deployment abstraction from the approved training example during data preparation; state it explicitly in the reviewed English design profile. Preserve that abstraction during generation and verify it on resolved AIR. A functional list does not by itself specify Process/Thread grouping.
record.semantic_choice: For the approved Isolette profile, allocate one Thread to each Process and preserve directed wrapper forwarding. Multiple Threads per Process remain legal under other explicitly approved profiles.
record.structural_placement: Place behavioral GUMBO contracts on their owning Thread as in the Monitor example. Show System/Process/Thread declaration order separately as a style observation; do not confuse source order with graph equivalence.
record.repair_gate: Check System/Process/Thread counts, direct containment, exact typed directed graph mapping, wrapper ports and forwarding, GUMBO ownership, and English assume/guarantee allocation. A matching shape does not discharge behavior, timing or implementation proofs.
prerequisites: Reviewed deployment profile and behavioral English
Successful Sireum parse and AIR capture
exclusions: Untouched final evaluation models as training sources
Applying one Thread per Process globally without profile approval
Copying omissions or defects from the example into behavioral requirements

parameters.name: deployment_profile
parameters.constraints: For Isolette one Thread per Process; explicitly review other groupings.

parameters.name: contract_owner
parameters.role: Thread that owns the required effect
parameters.constraints: Trace from English assumptions/guarantees; do not infer completeness from existing contracts.

target_compatibility: Selected KSU HAMR SysML/AADL profile with resolved Component AIR

counterexample.scenario: Four functions are placed as four Threads directly inside one Process while the approved design uses four single-Thread Processes inside one System.
counterexample.expected_difference: Both have four Threads but containment, wrapper ports and directed forwarding differ. Reject under this profile; do not reject a separately approved four-Thread Process design.

record.notes: Session-assistant proposal from the already approved original Monitor source plus explicit human design direction. The Regulator comparison is supervised development diagnosis, not independent evaluation or rule-release evidence. No new paid extraction call. No confidence value invented.
positive_paraphrases: each Process owns one corresponding Thread
misleading_near_matches: four functions imply four Threads in one Process

semantic_roles.effect: preserved containment and directed interface flows
semantic_roles.units_and_boundaries: one direct Thread per Process for this profile

record.formal_output_pattern: System -> Process(role) -> Thread(role); inputs forwarded inward, outputs outward. GUMBO assumptions/guarantees remain owned by responsible Thread. Source order is advisory.
allowed_edit_scope: approved generated target and its authorized wrappers

provenance.scope: Human-guided structural specialization; not independently validated or published
